TAS2O is a hands-on introduction to technological design. Students move from personal identity and digital design into CAD, fabrication, electronics, and an integrated project portfolio.
:::

## Course path

The course will be organized around short design-and-build cycles:

1. Starting Point
2. Identity, Logo & Emblem
3. Digital Design & Photopea
4. Measurement & Onshape
5. Fabrication & Materials
6. Electronics & Tinkercad
7. Integrated Project & Portfolio

Detailed lessons and the course sidebar are added in the next curriculum iteration.
:::
